# pve_acme_account (Data Source)

Reads an ACME account registered on this cluster (`GET /cluster/acme/account/{name}`), exposing the CA-reported directory URL, account URL, and Terms of Service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_acme_account" "default" {
  name = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) ACME account config file name to read (the API defaults to `default`).

### Read-Only

- `account_url` (String) The CA account URL as reported by the `location` field of the upstream account read response.
- `directory` (String) URL of the ACME CA directory endpoint.
- `tos` (String) The CA's Terms of Service URL.
